caption: Stop dieting. Let your body remember and guide how you eat #usahealth #wellnessjourney #chinesemedicineworks #wellness #healthybodyhealthymind
transcript: How many diets have you tried? Three? Five? More than you'd admit out loud? And you're still here. Still thinking about food all day. Still fighting cravings at 9 p.m. Still starting over on Monday. Here's what nobody tells you. It was never a discipline problem. Every diet hands you rules. Eat this, not that. Stop at this number. And every rule teaches your body the same thing. Your signals don't matter. Do that for years, and the signals go quiet. So you need the next diet. And the next. That's not you failing. That's the design. So try this instead. Before your next meal, pause for 30 seconds and ask one question. Am I actually hungry? Or am I just tired, bored, or stressed? Don't judge the answer. Just notice it. That one pause starts turning the signal back up. The rest is in my new book, The Body Remembers How to Eat.
